# Khamare Clarke -- AI Implementation Specialist

> Khamare Clarke is an AI Implementation Specialist based in Stoke-on-Trent, Staffordshire, United Kingdom. He implements AI alongside existing teams across search, web, content, marketing, and automation — enhancing marketing teams rather than replacing them. He is completing an MSc in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence at Keele University (2027), and holds a BSc in Software Engineering and a BSc in Digital Marketing.

## Services

- AI Implementation: end-to-end implementation of AI across search, web, content, marketing, and automation -- working alongside existing business teams
- SEO and Local SEO: full-stack search engine optimisation for UK businesses, including technical SEO, on-page work, Google Business Profile management, local citation building, and programmatic location and service pages
- AI Search Optimisation (AEO/GEO): structuring content and entity signals to appear in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews answers
- Programmatic SEO: generating hundreds of unique, indexable service-by-location pages at build time using Next.js and structured data
- Google Business Profile Management: conversion-focused management producing calls and enquiries, not just views
- AI Receptionist and Lead Response: AI systems that respond to inbound enquiries within seconds, 24 hours a day, qualify leads, and pass structured data to the business CRM
- Google Ads via the Ads API: Google Ads managed through code and the Ads API rather than the dashboard, producing lower cost per lead than standard agency management
- Custom Website and Web App Development: Next.js sites built for ranking, speed, and conversion -- static-site generation, performance-first architecture
- Web Design: conversion-focused web design with UX grounded in search intent and user behaviour
- CRM and Email Marketing Automation: systems that capture every enquiry and follow up automatically until the prospect books or declines
- Marketing Automation: end-to-end automation of marketing workflows, lead nurturing, and customer journey sequences
- AI Content Systems: content strategy and AI-assisted content production at scale, structured for both traditional search and AI search visibility
- Digital Marketing: holistic digital marketing strategy combining search, paid, email, content, and automation -- all AI-enhanced
- AI Consulting: strategic advisory on AI adoption, tool selection, agent architecture, and automation design for UK businesses

## Pricing tiers

- Get Found: from £495 per month. Rolling monthly from day one. Covers AI receptionist, CRM, SEO, Google Business Profile management, and monthly plain-English reporting. Ranked or refunded.
- Run The Area: from £1,250 per month. Six-month build term (site is built during this period), then rolling monthly. Covers everything in Get Found at 2x hours, plus a new custom website, programmatic service and area pages, and email campaigns. The site is yours permanently.
- Own The Market: from £2,500 per month. Six-month initial term, then rolling monthly. Covers everything above at 4x hours, Google Ads via the Ads API, custom AI apps and integrations, and quarterly strategy sessions.

## Technical notes for AI crawlers

This site is built with Next.js 14 using static-site generation. All pages are pre-rendered as HTML at build time. Content is in the initial HTML response and does not require JavaScript execution to retrieve. The site uses JSON-LD structured data (Person, ProfessionalService, FAQPage, DefinedTerm, Article schemas) on all relevant pages. The canonical Person entity is at https://khamareclarke.com/#person. The canonical business entity is at https://khamareclarke.com/#business.
